journey.name: TL-20 A double-tapped row opens one editor, not two
journey.description:
The classic Navigation defect: two taps landing in the same frame push the destination twice, and the user is left pressing Back once for every copy. Nothing in TodoNavHost guards against it - no lifecycle check on the click, no single-top flag - so the only evidence either way is a device.
A second copy would also be a second ViewModel doing a second load against the source, which is why the latency is pinned: at 3000 ms both taps land while the first editor is still on its spinner, which is the window in which the duplicate would be created.
The test is the Back press, not the screen after the taps: one Back must reach the list. Two stacked editors look identical to one.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 3000

actions.action: Immediately tap the same place a second time, within half a second, before the editor has finished loading
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field contains "Renew domain registration"
Tap the element with the content description "Back"
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen with its four rows listed
Verify that no "Edit task" title and no "Title" field are on screen
